label: TP
reason: User-supplied parameter 'BlCurated00089' is read directly via request.getParameter() and used in HTML attribute construction ('data-name'). The replace call only escapes double quotes (") which is insufficient for XSS prevention against script tags or other payloads; therefore unencoded malicious content can reach the browser.

evidence.note: Parameter flows directly into HTML attribute with incomplete quote-only escaping
